If **PaymentsService** is down, these two direct callers of its **PaymentsAPI** can no longer take payments:

- **OrderService** — calls PaymentsAPI to authorize and capture order payments. [order-service#Integrations]
- **RenewalsWorker** — calls PaymentsAPI directly to re-bill subscriptions monthly, without going through OrderService. [renewals-worker#Overview; renewals-worker#Integrations]

**PaymentsService** exposes **PaymentsAPI**, so both payment flows depend directly on its availability. [payments-service#Overview]
